content.title: Generic M8x30 Hex Bolt, Class 8.8 Carbon Steel, M8x1.25 Thread
content.short_description: M8x30 hex head bolt in Class 8.8 carbon steel with M8x1.25 thread pitch and 800 MPa tensile strength.
content.long_description:
This is a hex bolt, MPN M8x30, manufactured from carbon steel and rated to property class 8.8 with a tensile strength of 800 MPa. The fastener has a hex drive head and an M8 thread size with a 1.25 mm thread pitch, and an overall length of 30 mm.

Property class 8.8 carbon steel construction suits general industrial fastening applications where a defined tensile strength rating is required. The M8x1.25 thread pitch is a standard coarse-thread specification for M8 hardware, allowing compatibility with corresponding M8x1.25 nuts, tapped holes, and washers.

Use this bolt for mechanical assembly, equipment mounting, and structural connections where an M8x30 hex bolt with Class 8.8 rating is specified. Confirm mating thread pitch and grip length requirements against the 30 mm length before installation.
